synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO market notices report a City West transformer and an associated 275 kV circuit breaker tripped; AEMO did not instruct load shedding and was not advised of any bulk load disconnection.

document_statements.quote: At 1140 hrs, the City West 275/66 kV transformer T_1 and the 275 kV circuit breaker 6675 tripped during restoration of City West 275/66 kV transformer T_2.
AEMO did not instruct load shedding.
AEMO has not been advised of any disconnection of bulk electrical load.
The cause of this non credible contingency event is not known at this stage.
